items.title: Anat Cohen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 9, 2021
items.q: we’re playing with a new band called Quartetinho and Quartetinho it’s a part of the tentet... and then the vibraphone player and percussion player, James Shipp

ctx.x: Oh that’s a happy story. Well I appreciate you taking the time to speak with me and I’m looking forward to hearing you live. When you get to a particular venue that you haven’t been to before does the sort of physical layout, the stage, the auditorium affect your choice of repertoire?

It might not affect the choice of repertoire, it depends of course. It depends if it’s a band that has played enough that we have flexibility with repertoire, it might affect. But it definitely affects the way we play. It’s the whole, it’s the type of reverb in the room, it’s the type of instruments that are provided.
